knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Alarms are not bypassed. The correct response is to withdraw, contact the site representative and record the failure without the code.
A lost key is reported at once, with the time signed out and the last known place. The cleaner does not replace or copy it.
An unchecked item is recorded as unresolved and escalated. The site is not certified secure.

practicalCriteria: Completes a key checkout and return on the register in a simulated office, with every field filled in.
Withdraws from and records a simulated access-code failure without bypass, guessing or recording the code.
Completes a mock lock-up checklist item by item and escalates an unresolved item rather than signing it off.
passRule: Key register completed, access failure withdrawn from and recorded without the code, and unresolved lock-up item escalated rather than signed. Observed by an assessor in a simulated site. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
stopWorkCriteria: Alarm bypassed, or codes guessed or tried at another entry point
Controlled door followed through or credentials shared
Lock-up signed off with an unchecked item
Access code written down, photographed or sent
